bio: This endearing family inn has been serving well-crafted food, in which local producers take pride of place, since 1887! The elegant dining room which overlooks the countryside of southern Ardèche provides the perfect foil to sample Claude Brioude’s “Discovery” menu: a new spin on the omelette with Ardèche watercress, gravlax of trout and leeks, trilogy of lamb with a veggie pie…...
